findings.title: Nil TopicUser crashes unsubscribe
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb unsubscribe does TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id]) then immediately dereferences tu.notification_level. Users who have never entered the topic, who only have implicit regular state, or whose TopicUser was never created have no row, so tu is nil. Any such user clicking the email link gets NoMethodError on nil instead of unsubscribing. Must handle nil by creating/changing via TopicUser.change or defaulting to muted.

findings.title: State-changing unsubscribe on GET
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb TopicsController#unsubscribe mutates notification_level and calls tu.save! inside a GET action wired in config/routes.rb as get t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe. GETs are prefetched by email scanners, browsers, crawlers and are not CSRF-protected, so merely opening/scanning the email or link can silently change subscription state. State change must be POST/PUT/DELETE with CSRF/form token, or at minimum require confirmation.

findings.title: Unsubscribe lacks visibility check and error handling
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb unsubscribe builds TopicView.new(params[:topic_id], current_user) and then mutates TopicUser without guardian.ensure_can_see! and without rescuing Discourse::NotFound / Discourse::InvalidAccess the way show does. For private, deleted, secured-category or non-existent topics this raises unhandled 500 or leaks existence via redirect vs exception, and allows notification_level writes for topics the user cannot see. Must authorize visibility before mutating.

findings.title: Unsubscribe only steps down one level, still subscribed
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb unsubscribe does: if watching/tracking then set to regular else muted. A watching/tracking user clicking To stop receiving notifications about this particular topic, click here from config/locales/server.en.yml ends up on regular and will still receive mentions/replies, contrary to the page copy You will stop receiving notifications and the email promise. Either always mute or fix copy to explain two clicks are required.

findings.title: Email unsubscribe link requires login, fails logged-out
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb unsubscribe is behind before_filter :ensure_logged_in with no email token, while the link post.topic.unsubscribe_url is sent in notification emails. A recipient opening the email in a logged-out browser, different device, or email client is redirected to login and the unsubscribe never executes, making the advertised per-topic unsubscribe unusable. Needs a signed one-click token like DigestUnsubscribeKey or explicit login-then-confirm flow.
